name: Superhero Squad
pitch: The child joins The Brightside Brigade, a team of young heroes, and discovers a power of their own.
setting: Sparkport, a bright harbor city of rooftop gardens, sky trams, and a lighthouse headquarters

supportingCast.name: Zuzu Zoom
supportingCast.look: girl in a sky-blue suit who leaves rainbow trails when she runs

supportingCast.name: Tinwhistle
supportingCast.look: round teal robot with a lantern head and a kind voice

supportingCast.name: Pip
supportingCast.look: small orange fox wearing a tiny green cape

powerIdeas: The child's power connects to one of their favorite things.

starters.title: The Power Nobody Saw
starters.idea: The Brightside Brigade must rescue the town kite festival from a runaway wind, and the child doesn't have a power yet. Zuzu Zoom's speed and Tinwhistle's gadgets each fail. The child notices a small kid crying because their kite is lost and helps them first; that kindness turns out to be the child's power, which calms the wind.

starters.title: Pip's Big Day
starters.idea: Pip the sidekick wants to lead a mission but always trips. When the town's bridge bell won't ring, the big heroes try lifting and zapping and fail. The child lets Pip try and cheers him on; Pip's small size lets him reach the stuck clapper, and the bell rings for the whole town.
